newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Jan 2.

text.p: -- The state of Connecticut blasted Northeast Utilities top management for a poor safety record and called for the resignation of executives responsible for problems that have closed four of its nuclear reactors, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
Shares closed at 13-1/4 on Tuesday ahead of the Wednesday New Year's holiday.
-- AT&T Corp said it completed the spinoff of NCR Corp, distributing 101.4 million shares to AT&T shareowners.
ATT shares closed at 43-1/2 on Tuesday.

-- Severe floods hit the Northern California wine country, dumping up to six inches of rain in 24 hours and turning vineyards into muddy brown lakes. Sonoma Country declared a local state of emergency.

-- Boeing Co's chief executive Philip Condit said it bid for McDonnell Douglas Corp because it believed defense spending could start to grow again and it wanted a larger military business to benefit, according to the Financial Times of London.
